previewDeathNotice.description:
John passed away peacefully after a short illness at Mayo University Hospital. Husband of the late Kathleen (nee Morris). Deeply regretted by his son Sean, daughters Brid and Mary (Woolley), son-in-law Raymond, grandsons James, Luke and David, sister, Evelyn Lyons, brother-in-law, sisters-in-law, nephews, nieces, relatives and many friends.

R.I.P.

Reposing at Gilligan’s Funeral Home, Market Square, Claremorris from 6 o.c this Tuesday evening (27th March) until 8 o.c. Remains will arrive to St Colman’s Church, Claremorris on Wednesday for funeral Mass at 12 o.c with burial afterwards in St Colman’s Cemetery. 

House private on Wednesday morning please. Family flowers only. Donations if desired to The Irish Kidney Association c/o Gilligan Funeral Directors, Claremorris.
